Changes

  • 08/09/2021   Initial version.

  • 08/31/2021   Tests method MercuryService.editAccount().
  • 09/01/2021   Tests method MercuryService.getBankAccounts().
  • 09/11/2021   TestData.setSettingsForRequests() not used anymore.
  • 09/10/2025   Updated to use UUID.randomUUID(). API version updated to 64.0.
